insight: Y Combinator S24 company; raised a $3.8M seed (Dec 2024); founders previously built ML systems at Tesla and Citizen.
name: Hamming
tagline: Automated testing and monitoring for voice and chat agents.
description: Hamming is an enterprise platform for testing and monitoring conversational AI agents. It auto-generates test scenarios from an agent's prompt, load-tests with tens of thousands of concurrent calls, replays production calls for regression testing, and scores 50+ audio-native metrics like latency, hallucinations, sentiment, and compliance. It integrates natively with Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs, LiveKit, and Pipecat.

modelSupport.notes: Tests and monitors any voice or chat agent regardless of underlying model.

edge: Scores tone, interruptions and emotion from the call audio itself (~95% human agreement), not just the text transcript.
cons: No public pricing or free tier
